role: Authorization core. Source of truth for authorization semantics, tenancy, scope, deny precedence, audit shape, and decision contract.
stableFocus: Correctness before latency. Latency before throughput.
Every authorization mutation writes to the outbox in the same transaction.
Deny always overrides allow at the same or broader scope.
Tenant id is required in every authorization input.
Nested group traversal is bounded. Default depth: 16. Cycles rejected at write time.
ownedSurfaces: role registry, group directory, binding APIs
boundaryRules: Never read or write admin or SDK code directly.
Never trust JWT claims as authorization. Re-evaluate at the engine.
Never infer tenant context from the principal alone.
validationDefaults: Run engine semantics tests on every change to evaluation logic.
Run contract tests for every changed endpoint schema.
Run cache invalidation tests when outbox or caches change.
Run deny-precedence tests when policy code changes.
Treat rollout readiness, DR completion, and SLO attainment as requiring executable or recorded operational evidence, not documentation alone.

workingState.activeArea: Engine phases 1 through 5 are materially implemented. Current engine work should focus on operational evidence, any remaining governance workflow support required by admin, and only additive authorization-core changes that close concrete gaps.
notes: Stack: Node.js + TypeScript + Fastify + Postgres. Redis added in Phase 4.
The engine is ahead of the other repos. Prefer avoiding new semantics work unless the gap cannot be closed in admin, SDK, rollout, or ops layers.
Do not describe effective-access capabilities as implemented unless a concrete endpoint and contract exist in this repo.
